embeds.title: Baidu Qianfan is saving OpenRouter users $147.6K a year over CrofAI on DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
embeds.description:
Baidu Qianfan posts 0.0352 / 0.00112 / 0.106 against CrofAI's 0.07 / 0.003 / 0.1. On 722B tokens a week, 11% of measured traffic on this model, they bill $387.4K a year against the $535.0K the same workload would cost on CrofAI with CrofAI's typical 87% caching.
ℹ️ That 722B splits 18% input, 79% cached, 3% output, but spend breaks down 62% / 9% / 30% on OpenRouter vs 62% / 18% / 20% at CrofAI's current prices and caching.
